sentences.text:
Premlal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 26 February, 2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Ind:5758
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Gajendra Singh

On The 26th Of February, 2026
 Criminal Appeal No. 4725 of 2018
 Premlal
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
Shri Harsh Jain - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Jay Gopal Chouksey - G.A. for the respondent/Sta
 Order

This criminal appeal under section 374 of the Cr.P.C, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 30.11.2015 in Sessions Trial No.64/2012 by the learned Special Judge SC/ST (POA) Act, 1989,
Indore Barwani (M.P.) whereby the appellant/accused has been convicted under section 376(1) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, with further default stipulations.

The appellant/accused was prosecuted, convicted and sentenced regarding the incident dated 17.03.2012 in which appellant committed rape with the prosecutrix (PW-3) regarding which a crime no.129/2012 registered against the appellant at police station- Simrol, District- Indore (M.P.) under section under section 376 of the IPC.
Challenging the conviction as well as sentence this appeal has been preferred.

On perusal of the testimony of victim (PW-3), her husband (PW-4) and witness who has seen the appellant/accused running from the place of incident examined as PW-5, the conviction of the appellant accused under Section 376(1) of the Cr.P.C. does not require interference, hence it is affirmed.

The appellant accused has been convicted and sentenced for minimum sentence and as per the Jail Report No.2796/Warrant/2025 dated 04.11.2025 of Jail Superintendent, Central Jail, Indore, the appellant/accused was released on 07.08.2024 after completing the sentence and depositing the fine amount and, accordingly, this appeal has no substance
, hence, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
